questions.prompt: Which of the following is a type of symmetric clock tree architecture?
Which of the following statements does NOT explain the advantages of employing a mesh architecture over tree architecture for a global clock distribution network?
options: It allows us to obtain a very small skew in the clock distribution network.
It has a decreased impact of process-induced variations.
It is more robust to failure due to open circuit defects.
It has less short-circuit power dissipation in the drivers of the clock network.
questions.accepted: It has less short-circuit power dissipation in the drivers of the clock network.

questions.prompt: Clock skews are considered useful skews under which of the following conditions?
options: Skew can improve the testability of the circuit.
Skew can increase the system's maximum operable frequency.
Skew can reduce the defect in the manufactured circuit.
Skew can enhance the manufacturability of the circuit.
questions.accepted: Skew can increase the system's maximum operable frequency.

questions.prompt: Global Routing is the planning phase for which of the following tasks?
Global routing attempts to route each net with:
Which of the following techniques is employed to tackle via defects
options: Addition of integrated clock gating (ICG) cells

questions.prompt: Why do we need to make the metal density uniform over the layout by inserting dummy metal fills?
options: To improve the timing of the circuit
To reduce switching power dissipation in the circuit
To tackle signal integrity issues in the circuit
To improve the manufacturability of the circuit
questions.accepted: To improve the manufacturability of the circuit

questions.prompt: Which of the following task is NOT a signoff verification task?
For IC design, what do we mean by “tape out”?
options: Measuring the size of an IC using tape
Taking backup of netlist on a magnetic tape
Handing over the final IC layout to the foundry for fabrication
Adding magnetic tape to the IC design
questions.accepted: Handing over the final IC layout to the foundry for fabrication
